title: Add emerging callers as they release
context: Backlog (unscheduled) maintenance task for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark on a quarterly refresh cadence. As new fusion callers release, they are added behind the uniform adapter and re-benchmarked so the leaderboard stays current. This is a representative recurring task - the concrete caller set expands as tools are released. Operates on simulated/open data with full provenance.
objective: Add an emerging fusion caller behind the uniform adapter and re-run the benchmark, as part of the quarterly refresh cadence (representative recurring task).
acceptanceCriteria: The new caller is pinned by container digest behind the uniform adapter and emits the canonical FusionCall.
Benchmark re-run includes the new caller with CI + n + provenance; leaderboard updated.
CI smoke test passes for the new caller; reviewed by bio-rev/maint.
output: A pull request adding an emerging caller adapter + refreshed benchmark results (representative; recurs quarterly).
